name: Judea
line: Judea was the southernmost region of Palestine in Jesus' day, where Jesus was born, John preached in the wilderness, and the church was first scattered.

moments.title: Jesus born in Judea
moments.text: Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea during the time of King Herod. Wise men from the east, called Magi, came to Jerusalem asking where the newborn King of the Jews was.

moments.title: John preaches in the wilderness
moments.text: John the Baptist preached in the wilderness of Judea, telling people to turn away from their sins because God's kingdom was near. People from Jerusalem and all Judea went out to him, confessed their sins, and were baptized in the Jordan River.

moments.title: Time in the Judean countryside
moments.text: Jesus and His disciples went into the Judean countryside, where He spent some time with them and baptized. John's disciples heard that people were going to Jesus.

moments.title: Jesus warns people in Judea to flee
moments.text: Jesus said that when Jerusalem was surrounded by armies, those in Judea should flee to the mountains.

moments.title: The church is scattered
moments.text: After Stephen's death, a great persecution broke out against the church in Jerusalem. All except the apostles were scattered throughout Judea and Samaria, and they preached the word wherever they went.
